description: 仅特征 backbone（无分类头），用于 early fusion：与 FERsystem.backbone 一致

input.value_range: [0, 1]，与训练一致（图像 uint8 / 255，未做 ImageNet normalize）

forward: z = backbone(x); features = z.flatten(1)  # 形状 (N, feat_dim)
python_load_example: from emonet.ravdess_fusion_backbone import load_backbone_for_fusion, extract_features; bb = load_backbone_for_fusion('best_backbone.pth', backbone='resnet50', backbone_pretrained=true, device='cuda:0'); vec = extract_features(bb, images_batch, flatten=True)
python_load_from_full_model_example: from emonet.ravdess_fusion_backbone import load_backbone_from_full_model_ckpt, extract_features; bb = load_backbone_from_full_model_ckpt('best_uar.pth', backbone='resnet50', backbone_pretrained=true, device='cuda:0')
